boule-totale.name: Boule totale
boule-totale.shortDesc: A fortified semolina made from local maize, designed for the whole family.
boule-totale.fullDesc: Boule Totale is a fortified semolina made from carefully selected local maize. Enriched with vitamins A, B, C and essential minerals such as iron and zinc, it covers the daily nutritional needs of the whole family. Its fine texture and quick preparation make it an ideal complete meal for rural and urban families.
benefits: Rich in vitamins A, B and C
boule-totale.usage: Mix 3 to 4 tablespoons in hot water. Stir until smooth and homogeneous. Serve hot with milk or vegetables.

mwisho-mam.name: Mwisho MAM
mwisho-mam.shortDesc: A nutritional input specially formulated for the management of moderate acute malnutrition.
mwisho-mam.fullDesc: Mwisho MAM is composed of Soy, Corn, palm oil carefully sorted from the place of production to the processing plant and fortified with multi-micronutrients, a certified premix to provide effective therapeutic nutrition to stop the development of severe acute malnutrition and thus help the child or person suffering to recover.
mwisho-mam.usage: To be administered under medical supervision. Dosage according to the current MAM protocol. Consult a health professional before use.

uji-total.name: Uji - total
uji-total.shortDesc: A complementary food for children from 6 months, as well as pregnant and breastfeeding women.
uji-total.fullDesc: Uji Total is an enriched complementary food specially designed to support the growth of infants from 6 months and the health of pregnant and breastfeeding women. Its essential micronutrient composition promotes optimal cognitive and physical development in children while strengthening maternal health.
uji-total.usage: For infants: 2 to 3 spoons in lukewarm water. For adults: 4 to 5 spoons in hot water or milk. Serve twice a day.

grain-de-cacao.name: Cocoa bean
grain-de-cacao.shortDesc: Strengthens plant resistance against extreme conditions.
grain-de-cacao.fullDesc: Olidor's Cocoa Bean is an agricultural product selected from the best varieties, known for its exceptional resistance to difficult climatic conditions. It promotes vigorous growth, improves plantation productivity and guarantees a superior quality harvest, even in water-stressed areas.
grain-de-cacao.usage: Plant in well-drained soil with partial sun exposure. Water regularly for the first 3 months. Fertilize with a suitable organic fertilizer.

intrants-pec.name: Other PEC inputs
intrants-pec.shortDesc: Inputs and equipment for comprehensive malnutrition management.
intrants-pec.fullDesc: This range of inputs and equipment covers all the needs for malnutrition management (PEC) in community and hospital settings. It includes precision anthropometric measurement tools, diagnostic equipment, and supplies for continuous nutritional monitoring of patients.
benefits: Suitable for hospital and community settings
intrants-pec.usage: Use according to current malnutrition management protocols. Staff training recommended before use.

f100-f75.name: F100 and F75
f100-f75.shortDesc: Therapeutic milks used in the management of severe acute malnutrition.
f100-f75.fullDesc: F100 and F75 are internationally recognized therapeutic milks for the treatment of severe acute malnutrition (SAM) in hospital settings. F75 is used during the stabilization phase to prevent complications, while F100 supports the intensive nutritional recovery phase.
f100-f75.usage: Strictly under medical supervision. Prepare according to WHO clinical instructions. Administer in small frequent amounts according to the stage of management.

plumpy-nut.name: Plumpy-nut
plumpy-nut.shortDesc: Ready-to-use therapeutic food for community-based management of severe malnutrition.
plumpy-nut.fullDesc: Plumpy-nut is the world's most widely used ready-to-use therapeutic food (RUTF) for the community treatment of severe acute malnutrition. Based on peanut paste enriched with vitamins and minerals, it enables treatment outside the hospital, thereby reducing the burden on health systems.
benefits: Ready to use, no preparation needed
plumpy-nut.usage: Administer 1 to 3 sachets per day according to the child's weight. Provide sufficient clean drinking water. Regular medical follow-up recommended.

kit-pci.name: IPC Kit
kit-pci.shortDesc: Infection prevention and control in hospital settings and communities.
kit-pci.fullDesc: The IPC Kit (Infection Prevention and Control) brings together all the equipment and supplies needed to prevent and control the spread of infections in healthcare facilities and communities. It includes personal protective equipment (PPE), sterilization materials, and supplies for the safe management of biomedical waste.
kit-pci.usage: Use according to the infection prevention protocols in place at your facility. Train staff in the correct use of PPE before deployment.
